# Shared pricing calculations

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/pricing)

Compute channel-aware pricing breakdowns from explicit inputs and shared constants.

**Scope:** Pure calculation code; does not fetch prices, establish source rights or enable new paid commerce.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/pricing`.
